caption:
Before you pay a non-refundable fee, it is worth knowing whether your profile is ready.

Nobody can predict a consulate decision — and anyone claiming to is selling something. But the factors that weigh on it are well understood: residence stability, employment, financial history, travel record, and how well the file holds together.

Our free estimator walks you through them honestly, including when the answer is wait.

slides.body: The consulate decides, and anyone promising an outcome is selling you something they do not have.
slides.note: But the factors that weigh on it are well understood — and most of them are fixable.

slides.headline: ACTUALLY CARRIES WEIGHT
items: Residence stability — and how long it runs past your trip
Employment, and whether it is properly evidenced
Financial history rather than a single balance
Travel record, including any previous refusals
Whether the documents agree with each other

slides.headline: SOMETIMES THE HONEST ANSWER IS WAIT.
94.7% APPROVAL RATE ACROSS APPLICATIONS WE PREPARE
slides.body: That figure comes from auditing files before submission and declining to submit ones that are not ready. It is not a promise about your case — the consulate decides that.
slides.takeaway: We control the file. Not the decision.
